races.name: Country & Western Night 25th April Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: La Belle Forest
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to course, Burke stable in good form, ideal 27-day break

runners_data.name: Naana's Shadow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong 5f record, long absence is concern despite Scott's small string success

runners_data.name: Call Margot
runners_data.note: Hold-up style will struggle against moderate pace, trainer struggling for winners this month

runners_data.name: Filly Foden
runners_data.note: Recent winner who needs strong pace to aim at, Millman's 7% strike rate is poor

runners_data.name: Loleeta
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits race shape, 7lb claimer takes useful weight off in competitive contest

runners_data.name: Artista
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needs collapsing pace scenario, class winner who has been running consistently

runners_data.name: Alfa Duplicate
runners_data.note: Recent course winner with strong finishing kick, needs gaps to appear late

runners_data.name: Queensmaite
runners_data.note: Long absence makes her unreliable despite prominent style suiting race shape

runners_data.name: Star Marian
runners_data.note: Non-runner

races.paceDynamic: La Belle Forest will take them along from the front with no genuine pace rivals, setting a comfortable rhythm that she can sustain. Naana's Shadow, Loleeta and Queensmaite will track her prominently but lack the early pace to challenge the lead early. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Call Margot, Filly Foden, Artista, Alfa Duplicate) will be bunched at the back, relying on the pace collapsing. This moderate gallop strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can stay in contention without using energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runner controls
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Forest gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: She can kick clear turning for home when the hold-up horses are still gathering momentum. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to save enough for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent stalkers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slightly stronger with multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: Naana's Shadow and Loleeta can track the leader closely and have first run on her in the straight. Their prominent styles avoid the traffic problems that will hit the back markers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses swamp
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Forest sets too steady fractions and comes back to the field
scenarios.body: The closers get the perfect setup with a slow pace to aim at, but they need clear runs. Alfa Duplicate and Filly Foden have the best recent form to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If La Belle Forest goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where class and condition matter most. Only horses with recent winning form can capitalise on this lottery.

watchPoints.text: If La Belle Forest gets a soft lead she may prove very hard to peg back given her winning style
Naana's Shadow returning from 171-day break could need the run despite good historical form
Watch for traffic problems affecting the hold-up horses Call Margot and Artista in the straight
Filly Foden needs the pace to develop properly to showcase her finishing kick from the rear

races.name: GB Civil Engineering Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant Handicap

runners_data.name: Hiya Maite
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who should get ideal position tracking the leader but has been off form lately with four runs without a win

runners_data.name: Fidelius
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner with strong 5f record on similar going, Callan's 5lb claim is valuable but trainer struggling for winners

runners_data.name: Master Of My Fate
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent type with a recent win and good course form, Orr's booking suggests strong chances despite moderate official rating

runners_data.name: Spring Is Sprung
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who gets uncontested lead, Murphy's presence suggests confidence but form has been patchy this season

runners_data.name: Far Above The Law
runners_data.note: Returns from 170-day break which raises fitness concerns, but gets significant weight relief and Herrington stable in decent form

runners_data.name: Diomed Spirit
runners_data.note: Only confirmed hold-up horse who needs the pace to collapse, proven at the trip but may need more pace pressure to be effective

runners_data.name: Marty Hopkirk
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 232-day absence with fitness doubts, limited experience on all-weather surfaces is a concern

races.paceDynamic: Spring Is Sprung will lead from the gates with no other dedicated front-runners to pressure the pace, allowing for controlled fractions through the early stages. The prominent runners Hiya Maite, Fidelius, Master Of My Fate, Far Above The Law and Marty Hopkirk will settle just behind in a pack, while only Diomed Spirit represents the hold-up contingent from the rear. With one uncontested leader and minimal pace pressure, this sets up as a steady tempo that builds gradually, creating a tactical race where positioning and finishing kick matter more than raw early speed. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and pounce, as they get the best of both worlds - a sight of the pace without doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Spring Is Sprung gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the front-runner to conserve energy and maintain a telling advantage when the field closes late. Murphy's big-race experience proves decisive in judging the fractions perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and prominent runners get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: Fidelius or Master Of My Fate can use their superior recent form to collar the tiring leader in the final furlong. The moderate gallop plays into the hands of those with a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Diomed Spirit gets the perfect setup from the back as the field comes back to him late. Stuart Williams' horse has proven 5f form and the light weight aids his cause.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Hiya Maite or another prominent runner challenges Spring Is Sprung early
scenarios.body: The sustained pace burns out the early leaders and allows a closer like Far Above The Law to pick up the pieces. The race becomes a war of attrition favouring those held up longest.

watchPoints.text: Spring Is Sprung breaks quickly and establishes clear early lead - if uncontested this becomes very dangerous
Master Of My Fate and Fidelius both travel strongly into the straight as they represent the main threats to the leader
Diomed Spirit gets cover early and stays towards the rear as expected given his hold-up style
Far Above The Law shows any signs of ring-rustiness or struggles to keep up given the long layoff
The pace through the opening two furlongs sets the tactical template - slow fractions favour the leader, steady pace suits prominent trackers

races.name: Come Racing For Free 18th June Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Conference & Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Adjuvant
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 152 days off faces a tactical disadvantage if Senor Cortez gets an easy lead

runners_data.name: Carlton
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent form and headgear change who should get ideal positioning behind the leader

runners_data.name: Imperial Sovereign
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form on this surface but needs a stronger pace than likely

runners_data.name: Rock N Roll Pinkie
runners_data.note: Back-marker returning from 162 days who requires significant pace and perfect timing from Nolan

runners_data.name: Peaky Blinder
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with Oisin Murphy aboard whose class could tell if the race falls apart late

runners_data.name: Senor Cortez
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner carrying 7lbs less than main rivals who can control this small field throughout

races.paceDynamic: Senor Cortez will take this field along from the front with no serious pace pressure, having shown consistent early speed in his recent runs. Carlton may sit prominently in second but lacks the natural pace to challenge early, while Imperial Sovereign, Rock N Roll Pinkie, Peaky Blinder and Adjuvant will all settle further back. With just one committed front-runner, Senor Cortez can dictate terms and control fractions throughout the 2m½f trip. This setup strongly favours the leader and any horse with tactical speed to strike late, penalising pure hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Senor Cortez gets an uncontested lead and maintains control
scenarios.body: He can kick clear turning in with his 7lb weight advantage, while Carlton's prominent position gives him first run at the leader. The controlled pace neutralises the back-markers who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and one hold-up horse finds the perfect passage
scenarios.body: Imperial Sovereign or Peaky Blinder can utilise their class advantage and closing kick to reel in the front pair. Murphy's tactical skills on Peaky Blinder become crucial in engineering the right position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Carlton applies more pressure to Senor Cortez through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The two pace angles fight it out in the straight, with Carlton's superior recent form giving him the edge in a sustained battle. The hold-up horses get too far back to mount serious challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Back-Marker
scenarios.trigger: If Rock N Roll Pinkie or Adjuvant finds significant improvement returning from breaks
scenarios.body: Either could benefit from a fitness edge and surprise the field with untapped potential after lengthy absences. The soft pace would need to set up perfectly for a back-marker to succeed.

watchPoints.text: Senor Cortez getting too easy a time in front through the early stages with no pace pressure applied
Carlton's ability to track the leader closely enough to mount a challenge without over-racing
Imperial Sovereign and Peaky Blinder needing the pace to quicken significantly from halfway to be competitive
The overall tempo through the middle mile determining whether hold-up horses can get into contention
Mason Paetel's 5lb claim on Carlton making a difference in what could be a tight finish between the front pair

races.name: Ladies Day Sunday 16th August Handicap

runners_data.name: Eldrickjones
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest official rating but faces tactical disadvantage from the back with limited pace to aim at

runners_data.name: Star Studied
runners_data.note: Non-runner declared, removing one key pace angle from the early mix

runners_data.name: Silver Trumpet
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long 159-day break which raises fitness concerns despite decent course record

runners_data.name: Tilted Kilt
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with headgear changes (pacifiers) returning from 194-day layoff under William Knight's sporadic runners

runners_data.name: Down To The Kid
runners_data.note: Front-running specialist with perfect course record on similar going, Neil Callan knows him well

runners_data.name: Gunlock
runners_data.note: Handy racer who has shown versatility in trip but trainer Ross Burdon struggling for winners recently

runners_data.name: Shimmering Spin
runners_data.note: Prominent type with 7lb claimer Alexandra Egan taking off valuable weight, though returning from 112-day absence

races.paceDynamic: Down To The Kid will take the early lead from the rail with his prominent style and excellent course record, likely accompanied by Star Studied, Silver Trumpet, Gunlock and Shimmering Spin all wanting to race handily. This creates a competitive early pace with multiple horses vying for forward positions over the mile trip. The sustained pace will stretch the field and expose those trying to come from too far back. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good early positions, as hold-up horses Eldrickjones and Tilted Kilt face a difficult task from the rear with limited cover.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Duel Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Down To The Kid and the other prominent runners maintain strong early positions without over-racing
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays to their strengths as they're already well-placed turning for home, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the leaders who haven't stopped. Down To The Kid's course expertise and recent form make him the prime beneficiary.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: This allows the hold-up horses to pick up the pieces as the pace-setters weaken significantly in the closing stages. Eldrickjones and Tilted Kilt can use their superior finishing kicks to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get into an early speed duel trying to secure the rail position behind Down To The Kid
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up perfectly for a closer like Eldrickjones who has the class edge on ratings. Kevin Stott can time his challenge perfectly as the pace-setters battle each other into submission.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Down To The Kid sets a more measured pace that suits his stamina-laden profile
scenarios.body: His excellent course record and current form streak make him very hard to pass when getting his own way in front. The hold-up horses still face too much to do against a horse who knows this track intimately.

watchPoints.text: Down To The Kid breaking smartly and dictating terms from the front as his course record suggests he will
Eldrickjones getting squeezed for room in the straight as hold-up horses often do in small fields
Silver Trumpet showing any signs of needing the run after 159 days off the track
Tilted Kilt's headgear changes and long absence affecting his usual finishing kick
The pace through the early furlongs as multiple prominent runners jostle for position behind the leader

races.paceDynamic: Harswell River stands alone as the confirmed early leader and will dictate proceedings from the front without pressure. The prominent runners City Of Dreams, Hazy Cosmic Jane and Shes Got The Blues will sit within striking distance but none are natural pace-pressers. This creates a controlled tempo throughout with the large hold-up contingent including Electrocution, Akrivos, Captain Bruce and Lady Of Clover tracking from off the pace. The sustainable gallop strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays modest
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get perfect positioning as Harswell River weakens, allowing the closers to sweep past in the final furlong. Strong finishers with tactical speed like Electrocution and Akrivos are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Group Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can stay close enough to Harswell River without over-racing
scenarios.body: City Of Dreams and Hazy Cosmic Jane use their forward positions to steal a march when the pace lifts, holding off the late charge. Their tactical proximity gives them first strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-To-Wire Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Harswell River gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The leader finds an extra gear when pressured and holds on grimly as the field struggles to reel him back. His front-running style pays dividends when he's allowed to dictate completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses decide to pressure Harswell River early and create a messy pace
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes uneven with multiple moves, suiting horses that can adapt tactically like Musical Soldier and Dash Of Class. The race fragments and unexpected contenders emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Harswell River must be monitored closely for fitness given 128 days since last run as the lone pace-setter
Captain Bruce and Nicolai both show patterns of fading in the finish which could undermine their chances despite good positions
Watch for any early tactical moves from the prominent runners City Of Dreams or Hazy Cosmic Jane that might disrupt the expected pace scenario
Violet Goldsmith's 162-day absence is extreme even for a hold-up runner and makes her very hard to trust
Monitor Electrocution's position turning for home as his recent winning form makes him the most dangerous closer if getting the right trip
